name: print-social-navy-and-orange-hiring-cover-with-leather-office-chair
title: 'We Are Hiring! Join Our Creative Team' cover banner with an empty leather office chair and navy diagonal
whatItIs: A wide white-to-navy Facebook cover split by a diagonal, with a navy and orange headline ('We Are Hiring! Join Our CREATIVE & Professional Team!'), a navy box of open positions with arrow bullets, a black leather executive chair in the centre, and WhatsApp, address and tagline on the navy side.
whatItMeans: Aspirational and direct; the empty chair invites you to fill the seat.
techniques: Use an empty chair as a metaphor for a vacancy.
Split the banner with a diagonal between light and dark.
Highlight one word in an orange tag.

vocabulary.definition: An object standing for an idea, like an empty seat for a vacancy.
A slanted division between two areas.
